repaired_defects.symptom: The clean seven-year workflow could reuse a fixed end date instead of the approved latest completed NYSE session.
repaired_defects.repair: Validate an explicit decision timestamp, resolve the completed NYSE session once, and pass that same session to the engine and both clean-window gates.

repaired_defects.symptom: The post-book preflight required AlphaOps official books before the sidecar that produces them.
repaired_defects.repair: Give the gate an explicit target-book scope and validate only run_local operating books at the pre-sidecar boundary.

repaired_defects.symptom: Candidate replay rows omitted valuation_price_cutoff_date and feature_available_from.
repaired_defects.repair: Export both fields, anchor close-derived availability to the actual scheduled NYSE close including half days, retain later source timestamps, and fail closed on missing or mismatched first-decision provenance.

repaired_defects.symptom: The concentrated broker replay selected the first row of the same run comparison grid, producing an outcome-dependent N=1 configuration.
repaired_defects.repair: Ignore the unaccepted in-run comparison, retain explicit accepted metadata when present, otherwise use and integrity-check the registered legacy N=3 score-power monthly contract.

repaired_defects.symptom: Session and clean-window preflight evidence was not guaranteed in both minimal and official broker-ledger artifacts.
repaired_defects.repair: Publish the session gate, source preflight, post-book preflight, and their logs in both artifact profiles.

repaired_defects.symptom: A missing, zero-filled, after-close, or stale SEC-enriched candidate file could be reused and treated as policy-replay evidence.
repaired_defects.repair: Require non-empty Form4, 13F, and ETF PIT sources; actual scheduled NYSE-close candidate provenance; atomic output; and a source/output SHA-256 manifest rebuilt in the current run.

repaired_defects.symptom: Any one SEC artifact, including the enriched output itself, could self-certify data readiness before broker replay.
repaired_defects.repair: Require all raw stores plus a strict hash-bound enrichment contract and SEC columns in operating books before the primary broker replay starts.

repaired_defects.symptom: The approved source-manifest hash was format-checked only and the rebuild did not fail-loud on a stale latest selection cross-section.
repaired_defects.repair: Bind a safe tracked manifest path, exact dispatch scope, Git head, resolved session, and tracked-input hashes before expensive work; after calculation require exact-session scored/candidate/proposal rows and 100% eligible exact-close coverage.

repaired_defects.symptom: Monthly, weekly, 20-session timing, and hybrid ideas could otherwise be mixed without a stable causal definition.
repaired_defects.repair: Freeze A/B/C/D as one multiple-testing family with identical capital, fills, costs, PIT inputs, cash allocator, and no automatic promotion; D keeps routine replacement monthly and uses weekly signals only for monitoring or an allowed vacancy.

repaired_defects.symptom: The approved manifest and tracked inputs were hashed from a Windows CRLF worktree, so an exact Linux checkout of the same commit failed verification.
repaired_defects.repair: Use exact committed Git blob bytes for every approval digest, audit worktree bytes separately, and reject semantic worktree changes.

repaired_defects.symptom: Prefix-restored caches and refreshed external data could change while the run continued to claim only the same code-manifest identity.
repaired_defects.repair: Capture stage-specific file hashes after restore/refresh and again after final target mutation, bind them to the approved Git manifest, session, decision time, and workflow identity, and publish both manifests.

repaired_defects.symptom: A target override could run after readiness/freshness checks, and the sidecar could run after a failed strict upstream preflight.
repaired_defects.repair: Require upstream success, run every target mutation before runtime/readiness/freshness validation, and allow broker replay only after those final fail-loud gates.

repaired_defects.symptom: An unmatched Concentrated N=3 predicate could be silently skipped and operating-minimal could omit the registered 25/50/100 bps evaluation.
repaired_defects.repair: Fail on every missing/unmatched registered filter and require completed Main and Concentrated 25/50/100 bps sweeps in every canonical sidecar profile.

remaining_blockers.reason: A 2026-07-31 run-specific tracked source manifest is prepared. The canonical Main/Concentrated A strategy, exact seven-year window, USD 100,000 ledger, and 25/50/100 bps evaluation still require the exact separate FULLRUN_APPROVED authorization.
A/B/C/D definitions are frozen, but historical comparison remains blocked until canonical A is rebaselined and the complete experiment census authorizes one cadence/leadership family.

promotion_interpretation: Passing P0 tests authorizes neither a fullrun nor any portfolio mutation. It only makes a later explicitly approved fullrun fail closed on the repaired contracts.
